name: Vasant Sridhar
current_role: Co-Founder & Chief Strategy Officer, OfBusiness (OFB Tech), Gurugram
profile: Vasant Sridhar co-founded OfBusiness in 2015 with Asish Mohapatra, Ruchi Kalra and others. The Gurugram company runs B2B commerce for raw materials and SME financing (through its lending arm Oxyzo) and is valued at about $5B. He serves as Co-Founder and CSO.
interesting_fact: OfBusiness's team page lists him as a B.Tech graduate of IIT Madras who came to OfBusiness from ITC.
deep_cut_fact: Before OfBusiness he worked at the FMCG conglomerates ITC and Unilever, per his company and org-chart profiles.

public_contacts.value: https://www.ofbusiness.com/about/news (Press & Media page; PR lead Akansha Verma, VP PR & Corporate Communications, listed without email)

notes: Low public profile. Sources disagree on whether CSO means Chief Strategy or Chief Sales Officer. Best route is via OfBusiness's PR/corporate communications team.

name: Dheeraj Koneru
current_role: Co-Founder & SVP, Global Product Sales, Zenoti (Bellevue, WA / Hyderabad)
profile: Dheeraj Koneru co-founded Zenoti in 2010 with his brother Sudheer, who is CEO. Zenoti makes cloud management software for salons, spas, med spas and fitness businesses and is valued at about $2B. Dheeraj leads global product sales and drove the company's international expansion, including into fitness and gym management.
interesting_fact: Zenoti began as software he built in-house for the brothers' own Hyderabad chain, Latitudes Health Club and Tangerine Spas, after finding no suitable product on the market.
deep_cut_fact: He holds a PhD in particle physics from Cornell. He also co-founded Intelliprep Technologies, which later merged with Click2Learn, and held roles at Microsoft and SumTotal Systems.
notes: Some aggregators (Latka) wrongly list Dheeraj as CEO; per Zenoti, Sudheer Koneru is CEO. The Oct 2026 media contact is Dawn Cassidy at press@zenoti.com.

name: Brandon Woodward
current_role: Co-founder, TaxBit (Taxbit); current day-to-day role not confirmed
profile: Brandon Woodward co-founded TaxBit in Utah in 2017 with his cousins Austin Woodward (CEO) and Justin Woodward. TaxBit started as crypto tax software and now provides tax compliance and information-reporting software for digital assets and the gig economy. It raised $130M at a $1.33B valuation in 2021.
interesting_fact: TechCrunch reported that brothers Austin and Justin Woodward founded TaxBit with their cousin Brandon in 2017. The family team paired CPAs and tax attorneys with software developers from day one.
notes: Very low public profile; secondary sources describe his background as front-end development and design, but I couldn't confirm that from a primary source. Releases carry media contacts (media@/press@taxbit.com, agency Wachsman), but none could be confirmed on a fetched page, so none are listed. Best route is via the company or CEO Austin Woodward.
